requirement: This code should implement a function block named FB_DualAxisPower that controls the power state of two motor axes, Axis1 and Axis2, based on a boolean enable signal, bEnable. It should use two instances of the MC_Power function block, fbPower1 and fbPower2, to manage the power states of Axis1 and Axis2 respectively. Each MC_Power instance should be configured to start the drive and turn on the regulator when enabled. The function block should output four boolean statuses: bAxis1Ready and bAxis2Ready to indicate if each axis is ready, bBothReady to indicate if both axes are ready, and bError to indicate if there is an error in either axis. The readiness of each axis is determined by the Status output of the corresponding MC_Power instance, and the error status is determined by the logical OR of the Error outputs from both MC_Power instances.
provide_code:
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DualAxisPower
VAR_INPUT
	Axis1			:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;		//轴1引用
	Axis2			:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;		//轴2引用
	bEnable			:	BOOL := TRUE;	//使能信号
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
	bAxis1Ready		:	BOOL;			//轴1准备就绪
	bAxis2Ready		:	BOOL;			//轴2准备就绪
	bBothReady		:	BOOL;			//两轴都准备就绪
	bError			:	BOOL;			//错误标志
END_VAR
requirement_cn: 该代码应实现一个名为 FB_DualAxisPower 的功能块，用于根据布尔使能信号 bEnable 控制两个电机轴 Axis1 和 Axis2 的电源状态。它应使用两个 MC_Power 功能块实例 fbPower1 和 fbPower2 分别管理 Axis1 和 Axis2 的电源状态。每个 MC_Power 实例在启用时应配置为启动驱动器并打开调节器。功能块应输出四个布尔状态：bAxis1Ready 和 bAxis2Ready 表示每个轴是否准备就绪，bBothReady 表示两个轴是否都准备就绪，bError 表示两个轴中任一轴是否存在错误。每个轴的就绪状态由相应 MC_Power 实例的 Status 输出决定，错误状态由两个 MC_Power 实例的 Error 输出的逻辑或运算决定。
